title: BRT & SRT at COMOSA 2026 — Hanoi
body: Members of the Bio Research Team and Stress Research Team attended and presented two papers at COMOSA 2026 (Aug 7–8, Foreign Trade University, Hanoi). Read our conference coverage for highlights from the two days.

title: Two papers accepted at COMOSA 2026
body: Two of our papers have been accepted at the Conference on Optimization, Modeling, Simulation, and Analytics (COMOSA 2026, Aug 7–8, Hanoi): Behavioral Prior Elicitation via LLM for Heterogeneous-Agent Bitcoin Flash-Crash Simulation and A Leakage-Aware Multimodal Evaluation Framework for Early Intraoperative Acute Kidney Injury Prediction.

title: SMILESGNN paper accepted at MAPR 2026
body: Our paper SMILESGNN: Interpretable Clinical Toxicity Prediction via SMILES-Graph Cross-Attention Fusion has been accepted at the 9th International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR 2026, Aug 13–14, Hue).
